verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe fine-tuning a supported base model with Loops or running your own training code (Axolotl, TRL, custom) as Training Jobs. Checkpoints sync to storage, and any synced checkpoint can be deployed to a production endpoint on the same platform with one CLI command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the fine-tune-to-serve workflow works as documented.
